verses.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦਰਸ ਕਮਲ ਕੁਮਦਨੀ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rav sas dharas kamal kumadhanee hit bhramat bhramat man sa(n)jogee biogee hai ||

en.bdb: Both lotus and Nymphea lotus crave for a sight of The Sun and The Moon respectively. Because of their meeting and separating frequently, their love is besmirched.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰੋਗ ਰਹਤ ਅਰੋਗੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: tiragun ateet gur charan kamal ras madh makara(n)dh rog rahat arogee hai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-conscious person is ever engrossed in the elixir-like relishment of True Guru's feet after freeing himself from the influence of three traits of maya (mammon). His love is blemishless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਕੈ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਅਲੋਗੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: nihachal makara(n)dh sukh sa(n)paT sahaj dhun sabadh anaahadh kai log mai alogee hai ||

en.bdb: Such a God-oriented person stays free from the worldly affairs and remains engrossed in the mystical tenth door because of the unstruck music melody that keeps playing ere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਜੋਗੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੭॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal mahimaa agaadh bodh jog bhog alakh nira(n)jan prajogee hai ||267||

en.bdb: The wondrous state and glory of such a Guru-oriented person is beyond explanation and description. Guru-oriented person remains absorbed in the Lord who is imperceptible, beyond worldly pleasures, yet who is a yogi and a relisher (Bhogi) as well. (267)
